bullets.text: Public protest blocked the Chennai-Tirupati road near Periyapalayam due to a 5-hour power outage, and the office should monitor local electricity supply stability.

Gummidipoondi fire services conducted a fire safety awareness program for students, and the district team should support similar initiatives.

MeitY approved 12 projects under the electronics component manufacturing scheme, presenting an expansion opportunity for the portfolio team to track.
The Tamil Nadu government constituted an investment promotion commission headed by the Chief Secretary to boost free trade investments.

Kerala Law Academy invited papers for an international seminar on good governance and artificial intelligence, offering a platform for academic engagement.
